summary: Collapse current isolated studios into a canvas-centered document plus dockable tool-panel model.

targetTools.notes: Asset intake, certification, usage review, and generated catalog refresh belong in a dock/floating management panel.
Pixel painting, frame editing, onion skin, layers, and animation timeline should operate together around one sprite/atlas canvas.
Paper doll, equipment slots, rig/layer stack, animation preview, and atlas-layer assembly are panels around a character canvas.
Node palette, graph inspector, script text, validation, and runtime event bindings are dockable panels.
Mixer, procedural/MIDI nodes, waveform/timeline, and instrument/source browsers are panels.
